metric_value: cargo test --all-features 2>&1 | awk '/test result:/ { for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="failed;") sum+=$(i-1) } END { print sum+0 }'
cargo test --all-features -- cursor_guard io_other 2>&1 | grep -E "^test |^test result"
cargo llvm-cov --all-features 2>&1 | awk '/TOTAL/ { for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i~/[0-9.]+%/) { gsub(/%/,"",$i); print $i+0; found=1; exit } } END { if(!found) print -1 }'
